title: Bifocal: Training-Free Mixed Granularity Visual Token Pruning for Multimodal LLMs
title_zh: Bifocal：面向多模态大型语言模型的免训练混合粒度视觉令牌剪枝

paragraphs.en: Bifocal是一种免训练的视觉令牌剪枝方法，能显著提高多模态大型语言模型在精细任务上的性能。 Visual token pruning for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) appears highly effective, with existing methods retaining over 95% of unpruned performance on common VQA benchmarks using a quarter of the visual tokens or fewer. However, our extensive evaluation of ten methods across three MLLM families and five ability groups reveals a critical gap: strong general performance often comes at the cost of severe degradation on fine-grained tasks such as OCR and visual grounding. We trace these failures to two limitations of the prevailing paradigm of retaining the highest-ranked native patches. A single importance ranking overlooks the complementary evidence required by different tasks, while sparse patch selection disrupts both image content and spatial integrity. To address these limitations, we propose Bifocal, a training-free, two-stage pruning method built on a mixed-granularity framework. It allocates separate budgets to query-focused and image-intrinsic evidence, complemented by a pooled coarse representation of the entire image. Before the LLM, Bifocal matches question words to visual regions through a soft conjunction balanced against norm-debiased image saliency, while selecting image-intrinsic evidence to maximize representational coverage. Inside the LLM, it further prunes tokens using density-adjusted text-to-image attention. With roughly a quarter of the original visual tokens, Bifocal is the only evaluated method to retain over 90% of unpruned performance in every ability group across all three models, and ranks first on average in all nine model-budget settings. The code is available at: https://github.com/EIT-NLP/Bifocal
paragraphs.zh: Bifocal 是一种无需训练的视觉令牌剪枝方法，能够显著提升多模态大型语言模型在精细任务上的性能。针对多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）的视觉令牌剪枝方法展现出极高的有效性：现有方法在使用不到四分之一的视觉令牌时，仍能在常见的 VQA 基准测试中保留超过 95% 的未剪枝性能。 然而，我们对十种方法在三类 MLLM 和五个能力组上的广泛评估揭示了一个关键问题：强大的整体性能往往以精细任务（如 OCR 和视觉定位）性能的严重下降为代价。 我们将这些失败归因于当前主流范式——保留排名最高的原始图像块——的两个局限性。 单一的的重要性排序忽视了不同任务所需的互补性证据，而稀疏的图像块选择则会破坏图像内容和空间完整性。 为解决这些问题，我们提出了 Bifocal：一种基于混合粒度框架的、无需训练的两阶段剪枝方法。 它为查询导向的证据和图像内在的证据分配了独立的预算，并辅以对整个图像进行池化后的粗粒度表示。 在 LLM 之前，Bifocal 通过软连接词将问题词汇与视觉区域匹配，同时平衡基于范数偏差校正的图像显著性；同时选择图像内在证据以最大化表示覆盖范围。 在 LLM 内部，它进一步利用密度调整后的文本到图像注意力机制对令牌进行剪枝。 仅使用约四分之一的原始视觉令牌，Bifocal 成为所有受评估方法中唯一能在全部三个模型、每个能力组中保留超过 90% 未剪枝性能的方法，并在所有九种模型预算设置中平均排名第一。 代码可在以下地址获取：https://github.com/EIT-NLP/Bifocal
